description: Lookalike-domain alerts, yearly: buy it in one x402 payment. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /buy/brandwatch, $990 in one payment), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. A free check first: POST the same body to /buy/brandwatch/check (email required).

items.description: optional 0x EVM contract address you publish in your own docs

email.description: optional: where to send the files too; without it they are on the order status page

name: buy_brandwatch
